unit: one independent paired outcome per family; also represents perfectly correlated repeats
assumptions: Hypothetical iid family pairs with probabilities gain=(q+delta)/2,loss=(q-delta)/2,tie=1-q. No parameter estimated from a new experiment. This does not model teacher selection, act strata, a second comparator, cross-family policy learning or multiplicity; those can change power. It is not a policy result.
conclusion: 128 families do not establish adequate sensitivity to modest action gains without an effect/variance model; repeating deterministic continuations does not increase independent families.
